title: Anna at the Doctor
text:
Anna is sick today. She has a cold. She has a headache and a cough. Her mother takes her to the doctor.

The doctor is kind. He looks at Anna's throat and gives her medicine. Anna must drink a lot of water and rest in bed. In three days, she feels better.

questions.text: What does the doctor give Anna?
Why does Anna's mother take her to the doctor?
options: Because Anna wants a new toy
Because the doctor is her friend

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's illness?
options: It lasted for a long time
It was caused by a broken bone
It made her stay in hospital for a week

vocabulary.definition: an illness that makes your nose run and makes you cough
a person who helps sick people
something you take to make you feel better when you are ill

paragraph_translations: Аня сьогодні хвора. У неї застуда. У неї болить голова і є кашель. Мама веде її до лікаря.
Лікар добрий. Він дивиться Ані в горло і дає їй ліки. Аня повинна пити багато води і відпочивати в ліжку. Через три дні вона почувається краще.
